title: 2003 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement: A ship travels from point \(A\) to point \(B\) along a semicircular path, centered at Island \(X.\) Then it travels along a straight path from \(B\) to \(C.\) Which of these graphs best shows the ship’s distance from Island \(X\) as it moves along its course?

solutions.text:
Every point on the semicircular path from \(A\) to \(B\) is the same distance from the center \(X,\) so the graph starts horizontally.

On the straight path from \(B\) to \(C,\) the ship first gets closer to \(X\) and then farther away from \(X.\)

Only graph \(B\) starts flat and then decreases before increasing.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Along the semicircle, the distance from \(X\) is constant.
On the straight segment, the ship first gets closer to \(X,\) then farther away.
